headline: Peruvian Sol Leads Regional Currency Gains as US Dollar Closes at S/3.42
summary: The Peruvian sol appreciated 0.55% as the interbank US dollar rate fell to S/3.426 from S/3.445, outperforming Latin American currency peers.
why: Peru's sol is backed by substantial central bank foreign exchange reserves and key copper export revenues.

impacts.name: Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: Interbank dollar selling lifted the Peruvian currency to lead Latin American foreign exchange gains.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Commercial interbank inflows and positive regional export sentiment boosted the sol relative to the US dollar.
